d: As an Advanced Field Service Engineer here at Honeywell, you will have the opportunity to provide advanced technical facilitation and expertise to our customers in the Process Automation (PA) business unit. You will be accountable for troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues, ensuring the successful implementation of our solutions, and driving customer satisfaction. Your expertise and dedication to excellence will play a crucial role in the success of our field service operations and the growth of our business. You will report directly to our Field Service Engineering Manager, and you'll work out of our Kuwait location on a hybrid work schedule.
In this role, you will impact the efficiency, productivity, and safety of our customers' operations by providing exceptional technical facilitation and service.
q: Hands-on experience of EPKS Server and Station Maintenance - 10 years with 8 + years’ experience as senior FSE (service and maintenance).

Clear with 3rd party integration protocols and communication protocols
Minimum certification EPKS L4 & OPM L3.
Experience of carrying out OPM, Patch updates, Controller and IOP firmware upgrades on an online system
Engineers with Oil and Gas / Petrochemical / Refinery industry experience.
Must have experience to work on Honeywell Safety Manager

Knowledge of networking components like switches, routers and firewall
Knowledge of Peripheral Honeywell systems like Dynamo, APC

x: Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. d: Business Director leads parts sales, imports, warehousing and distribution operations to drive business growth, profitability, cost efficiency, and operational excellence within the company’s delegated authority.
q: Education and Experience: Post Graduate Diploma with 16 years of experience or Bachelor’s degree with 19 years of experience.
r: Formulate strategic plans and budgets for Parts sales logistics, and distribution operations to drive long-term business growth and achieve targeted results.
Identify the strategic business and market trends in the areas of parts sales, inventory, warehousing, and distribution and ensure implementation of best practices.
Participate in due diligence in order to assess the business/function implications for mergers and acquisitions and recommend solutions.

Plan and direct marketing and commercial activities of parts, such as pricing, product mix, promotions, advertising, sales targets, etc so that agreed profit, sales and market share targets are achieved in order to obtain competitive position in industry.
Plan and direct the sales activities of parts to ensure that the services rendered to customers are of the highest quality in order to achieve the targeted customer satisfaction level (NPS) score.

Compile and forecast the present and future needs of business units in terms of warehousing and distribution and plan the inventory and distribution operations accordingly in order to provide the level of service meeting business SLAs.
Plan and direct the acquisition of new and management of existing facilities and equipment to meet current and future logistics needs.
Develop service level agreements with internal customers and drive the functions in order to adhere to their terms and conditions.
Develop inventory goals in order to balance industry product delivery lead-times, inventory turn rates, internal customers and principal requirements and satisfaction.
Develop the logistics infrastructure that supports internal customers’ business requirements, timely delivery of goods and products, and achieve cost effective distribution operations.
Develop business processes and solutions in order to reduce obsolete and dead stock items, damaged stock items, and shortage of stock.

Review the overall business processes, systems and performance and develop improvement initiatives based on analyzing statistical data to monitor and control the operations effectively and achieve set financial targets.
Ensure that both periodic and surprise physical inventory count are conducted and that discrepancies are documented, reported and dealt with appropriately.
Ensure BU compliance with the Group policies and procedures, in areas of purchasing, IT, HR, etc
Represent the Al-Sayer Group and negotiate with principals for matters pertaining to product mix, pricing strategy, marketing and branding, supply chain, competition, etc
Ensure adherence to health and safety procedures and standards for the function of inventory and distribution.

Evaluate and advise on the impact of new regulatory actions, such as new laws, import and export regulations, customs’ regulations, on the inventory and distribution function and ensure full compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Report periodically on the business performance to management, track business KPIs and budgets, review analysis of activities, costs, operations and sales and data forecasting to determine progress toward stated goals and objectives, operations cost effectiveness, reduce waste, and take corrective measures as necessary.
Maintain knowledge of developments trends and best practices in the area of Parts sales and logistics operations and assure they are incorporated in the future business models of Al-Sayer Group.
Lead and mentor the team, fostering a culture of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Prepare the manpower budget pertaining to required staffing levels, training and development, internal mobility and succession.

Identify objectives and KPIs, review the performance and potential of staff and make/approve decisions relating to appointment and termination, promotions and salary adjustments, disciplinary action, succession planning and development plans.
Ensure increasing levels of employee satisfaction and improve the efficiency of manpower.
Make requisite attempts to handle all grievances raised by subordinates in a prompt and effective manner.

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
q: At least 5 years of relevant experience in risk management, market surveillance or regulatory oversight within a digital asset business or regulated financial institution.
Hands-on experience investigating trading activity, with a strong understanding of market abuse, market microstructure and order books.
Experience developing risk frameworks, governance documentation and management reporting, and supporting licence applications or regulatory reviews.
Familiarity with digital asset products, exchange operations and regulatory expectations for licensed businesses.
Strong analytical, investigative and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across teams.
A degree in finance, economics, law, risk management or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience with surveillance platforms such as Solidus Labs, Nasdaq SMARTS or Eventus.
Working knowledge of SQL, Python or other trading data analysis tools.
Experience supporting regulated entities or licensing projects across multiple jurisdictions.
Relevant professional qualifications, such as FRM or CFA.
r: Develop and maintain risk frameworks, assessments, risk appetite measures and controls for regulated digital asset businesses.
Oversee market surveillance, investigate potential market abuse and coordinate escalations and regulatory reporting with Compliance and Legal.
Improve surveillance systems, monitoring scenarios and alert thresholds, ensuring effective data coverage and investigation processes.
Lead risk and surveillance workstreams for VASP and equivalent licence applications, including regulatory documentation, regulator engagement and operational readiness.
Report key risks, surveillance findings and remediation progress to management and boards. Partner with internal teams to assess new products, business changes and jurisdictional expansion.
